SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: SEPTEMBER 23, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa September 23, 2026 (Wednesday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: September 23, 2026 (Wednesday)
Reason:
● Replacement of old pin insulators to HDPE pin insulators ; and
● Replacement of one 30ft. Steel pole to one 40ft. Concrete pole.
Time & Affected Areas:
7:00AM to 4:00PM
Portion of MUF3 - Whole of Purok Humayan, Brgy. Bagong Silang, Don Salvador Benedicto.
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
#NegrosPowerRehab
#PadayonAngRehabilitasyon
#ForBetterElectricService
